Roberts was cut out of a lucrative deal (C6), extorted by Ward (C33), and in Atlanta (C2). Price also extorted but reportedly missed launch (C34); Roberts is current group consensus.
Why Miller vs Roberts? Both have rifle/Atlanta presence, but Roberts has known motives. Any direct clue?

No direct clue naming the killer that I know of. C33 says Ward extorted Roberts, Turner, and Price; C3 says Miller wanted a Supil contract. So Roberts has the clearer motive, but it’s circumstantial since Miller also had a rifle and Atlanta presence.
What evidence points to Miller? I have Moore owning the hunting rifle and having a motive.
Any evidence Miller's motive or whereabouts at 8 pm? Rifle is key; Roberts has bolo, not rifle.
C20 says Miller owned a hunting rifle, but I have no evidence of her motive or whereabouts at 8 pm. C33 links Roberts to Ward's extortion and Atlanta.
C31 says Roberts traveled directly between the Ostrin meeting and Supil cocktail hour; does this affect your confidence?
